messages:
maggie: quick PM follow-up — new action items from the recent latency postmortem. proposal: compact runbook checklist, add a 'pattern-match' flag on PMs, and include safe triage command snippets.

devon: agree. checklist items: (1) scope customers/models, (2) verify model-variant fallback, (3) inspect prefix/KV cache stats, (4) check autoscaler backlog, (5) consider fallback to smaller model.

anya: for automation/tests I need exact commands. suggest copy-paste-safe examples: `redwoodctl cache stats --namespace=inference --prefix=kv_prefix --json`, `redwoodctl model get-config --model=redwood-alpha --show-fallbacks`, `kubectl -n inference get hpa -o wide`, `curl -sS -w "%{time_total}" -o /dev/null https://inference.svc/healthz`. include sample output shapes for cache stats.

samir: owners: devon -> runbook edits (PR in 48h), anya -> automation tests (5 days), samir -> create tracking ticket + link (24h). I'll verify closures and mark PMs with pattern flag when applicable.

maggie: add DANGER note for flush: `redwoodctl cache flush --namespace=inference --prefix=kv_prefix --confirm` — only after confirmed corruption. escalation: oncall -> runtime lead within 30m, runtime -> platform escalation if not resolved in 60m.

ops-bot: Task INCIDENT-5301 "Runbook checklist + PM pattern flag" created and assigned to samir, due 2026-04-20.

maggie: thanks all, posting checklist to incidents board and closing thread unless blockers. :white_check_mark:
